newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - March 31.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Hog prices plunge further, agriculture officials seek countermeasures.
Police arrest shooting suspect Huang Tsu-wang.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Communist Chinese leader Jiang Zemin says a Taiwanese could be China's vice president after reunification.
Taiwan-Osaka flight expected to be resumed.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan ranks as eighth most corrupt nation in Asia.
Taiwan to spend T$7 billion (US$255 million) for anti-smuggling equipment.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Economics Ministry and Mainland Affairs Council discuss Formosa group's unauthorised China power plant project.
Taiwan unemployment rate reaches peak despite lack of workers.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Satellite communication services to be opened to private participation.
Asia's economic scale to surpass United States and Europe in 2010.
